rules.title: Focus ring contrast
rules.rule: A focus ring reaches 3:1 against every adjacent color it crosses.

rules.title: Text contrast
rules.rule: Text reaches 4.5:1 (large text, 24px+ or 18.67px+ bold, 3:1) against the background it actually renders on, in light and dark, including translucent surfaces.

rules.title: Non-text contrast
rules.rule: Control boundaries, states and meaningful graphics reach 3:1 against adjacent colors.

rules.title: APCA report
rules.rule: Report APCA Lc alongside WCAG 2 (body Lc 75, labels 60, large 45, icons 30-45); gate on WCAG 2 only.

rules.title: Legible placeholder and disabled text
rules.rule: Disabled and placeholder text aims for APCA Lc 30.

rules.title: No color literals
rules.rule: Components hold no hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() literals, and a change never swaps a token for a literal or a lighter token without remeasuring.

rules.title: One color notation
rules.rule: Write colors in the project's notation (DS: lowercase hex).

rules.title: Semantic tokens in components
rules.rule: Components use semantic role tokens; hue tokens only for categorical color.

rules.title: Token names by role
rules.rule: Semantic token names describe a role, never a hue, component or position.

rules.title: Accent is the brand word
rules.rule: Call the brand color 'accent' so 'primary' never means two things.

rules.title: Tokens in their role
rules.rule: Use a token only in its role: no border token in color:, no text token in background:, no accent on text.
rules.notes: DS rule 5: text uses color.link, never color.accent.

rules.title: One word per concept
rules.rule: Pick one word per concept (text, bg, border, accent) and never mix synonyms.

rules.title: Ramps hold one hue
rules.rule: A ramp steps lightness at one perceived hue.

rules.title: Fine light end
rules.rule: Light-end steps sit about 0.04-0.05 OKLCH L apart; mid-ramp 0.07-0.10.

rules.title: Distinct steps
rules.rule: No two adjacent ramp steps are within 0.03 OKLCH L.

rules.title: Chroma peaks mid-ramp
rules.rule: Vividness peaks mid-ramp and falls off at both ends.

rules.title: Ramp ends not pure
rules.rule: Ramps stop short of pure black and white.

rules.title: Sibling hues match
rules.rule: Sibling hues share OKLCH lightness and relative chroma so the same step reads equally bright.

rules.title: Status hues apart from accent
rules.rule: Every status hue sits 15 degrees or more of OKLCH hue from the accent.

rules.title: One color, one meaning
rules.rule: A color (within 15 degrees of hue) has one purpose across the interface.

rules.title: One filled action
rules.rule: One primary action per view gets the filled accent; peers stay neutral.

rules.title: No unused steps
rules.rule: Every palette step has a purpose; remove ramps and steps nothing renders.

rules.title: No near-duplicate colors
rules.rule: Colors within 0.02 OKLab deltaE are one drifted color; collapse them.

rules.title: Real dark palette
rules.rule: Dark tokens are a separate palette, not the light ramp reversed.

rules.title: One theme mechanism
rules.rule: Switch themes one way only.
rules.notes: DS uses data-theme="dark" with .dark as an alias of the same selector; that counts as one mechanism.

rules.title: Dark coverage
rules.rule: When dark ships, every custom color has a dark variant.

rules.title: prefers-contrast per appearance
rules.rule: prefers-contrast: more gets its own value per appearance, widening the gap by 0.15 L or more.

rules.title: In-gamut colors
rules.rule: oklch() colors stay in the target gamut, with an sRGB value first and vivid values inside @media (color-gamut: p3).
rules.notes: DS colors are hex today, so this applies only to new oklch values.

rules.title: Consistent neutral tint
rules.rule: A neutral's tint is held across its ramp.

rules.title: Full role inventory
rules.rule: The token set covers every role: surfaces, text levels, borders, focus, accent and shipped statuses.

rules.title: Gradient interpolation space
rules.rule: Multi-hue gradients declare their space: oklab by default, oklch only for vivid midpoints checked for detours; keep text off gradients.
rules.notes: Skill calls this taste; magazine states it. Kept as warn with oklab default.

rules.title: Round glows are circles
rules.rule: Set circle explicitly when a radial glow must stay round.

rules.title: Locale color meaning
rules.rule: Gain/loss colors that change meaning across locales are per-locale tokens.

rules.title: Gradient techniques
rules.rule: Hard edges with same-position stops, textures with repeating gradients, midpoints with color hints, richness with a low-alpha blended layer.

rules.title: Shadow ring keeps a border
rules.rule: A box-shadow ring keeps border: 1px solid transparent for forced-colors mode.

rules.title: Image outline
rules.rule: Content images get a 1px outline inset 1px in pure black at 10% (light) or pure white at 10% (dark).
rules.notes: Issue 19 says 8%; issues 09 and the skill say 10%. 10% wins. Needs a DS token (see token proposals).

rules.title: Icons use currentColor
rules.rule: Icons use currentColor and get states from CSS color and opacity, never hardcoded fills.

rules.title: Theme before first paint
rules.rule: The resolved theme applies before first paint; the app follows the system with a Light, Dark and System choice.
